title: Model each exchanged artifact as a theme-namespaced, URN-identified, location-mirroring unit

facts.note: planner-authored plan, wagon, WMBT, acceptance and planning-doc files are path-identifiable
file kind derived from path / extension; planning_doc = documentation files under the planning area (e.g. markdown docs alongside plans/wagons) that define exchanged artifacts
task text mentions artifacts being produced/consumed or named

values: artifact declared, renamed or referenced in produce/consume lists
facts.note: diff-level observer needed to detect a new/changed artifact declaration in a wagon, plan or planning doc

values: artifact meaning ambiguous (runtime cargo vs domain artifact)
facts.note: whether an item is a domain artifact versus runtime cargo is a semantic judgement

fires: A planner adds a new produced or consumed artifact to a wagon during domain decomposition
A planner names or renames an artifact URN referenced by WMBTs or acceptances
A planner writes a planning doc or plan that defines what material/contract/schema wagons exchange
doesNotFire: A coder/tester implements the runtime transport of cargo in flight for an already-declared artifact
Editing a plan section that neither declares nor references any exchanged artifact
A validator run checking naming details — those are enforced by the planner.artifact-naming.* rules, not this anchor

given: A plan, wagon, WMBT, acceptance or planning doc declares or references a unit wagons produce or consume (material, contract, schema).
when: The planner names or decomposes that exchanged unit.
then: Model it as an artifact: a domain unit naming WHAT is exchanged, URN-identified, theme-namespaced, following theme:hierarchy:aspect.variant, with identity mirroring its declared location.
prefer: Make the top segment a canonical theme (.theme-taxonomy).
Colon for hierarchy, dot for variant (.naming-pattern, .separator-semantics).
Reference it from the WMBTs and acceptances that prove it.
avoid: Describing it as runtime cargo in flight — a coder/tester concern.
Citing this anchor as the enforcement point; the requiring rule nodes enforce it.
why: A stable shared meaning of 'artifact' lets wagons, WMBTs and acceptances agree on WHAT is exchanged; enforceable parts live in the naming rules that require this anchor.
evidence: Advisory semantic anchor: not itself bound to a validator; compliance is established transitively by the requiring nodes (planner.artifact-naming.urn-structure, schema-identifier, theme-taxonomy, naming-pattern, separator-semantics, contract-file-mapping, logical-physical-mapping, validation-rules).
Reviewer confirms the artifact is described as a produced/consumed domain unit (material, contract, schema) exchanged by wagons and proven by WMBTs/acceptances, not as runtime cargo.
verifier_detail: No detector binds to this node directly; it enforces nothing. Verifiers must evaluate the decomposed constraint/rule nodes that require it.

Property map: artifact -> {urn-identified, theme-namespaced, naming-patterned, location-mirroring}. urn-identified: has a structured URN -> planner.artifact-naming.urn-structure, planner.artifact-naming.schema-identifier; theme-namespaced: top segment is a canonical theme -> planner.artifact-naming.theme-taxonomy; naming-patterned: follows theme:hierarchy:aspect.variant with colon/dot separator semantics -> planner.artifact-naming.naming-pattern, planner.artifact-naming.separator-semantics; location-mirroring: logical identity mirrors physical/contract location -> planner.artifact-naming.contract-file-mapping, planner.artifact-naming.logical-physical-mapping.
Prefer-list short ids ('.theme-taxonomy' etc.) abbreviate planner.artifact-naming.<id>.
audit: source name: Artifact — advisory semantic anchor

term semantic_anchor (label 'Advisory semantic anchor'): a definitional node that gives the artifact a stable meaning but is not itself bound to a validator; it is transitively protected by the enforceable constraint/rule nodes that require it.
term artifact (label 'Artifact'): artifact -> {urn-identified, theme-namespaced, naming-patterned, location-mirroring}.

additions.text: Planner-facing obligation phrasing ('Model it as an artifact ...') for a source that is a definition, not an imperative.
additions.justification: Schema needs one obligation; the source is an advisory definition, so the definition is restated as the modelling move a planner makes. No new requirement beyond the source meaning.

additions.text: Activation facts (including file_kind planning_doc), fires and doesNotFire cases.
additions.justification: Required by the schema; derived from the source's scope (planner domain decomposition vs coder/tester runtime realization). planning_doc added so the planning-doc case in given/fires is reachable.

additions.text: Reference it from the WMBTs and acceptances that prove it.
additions.justification: Restates S006 ('that WMBTs and acceptances prove') as a planner move; no new enforcement.
